item.title: Incarico post-doc: Role of Schwann cells within tumour microenvironment in liver cancer and melanoma (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-02 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Rome
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-12 Anatomia umana

Study of the contribution of peripheral nerves to processes of neovascularisation associated with tumour growth, through structural, ultrastructural and immunohistochemical analyses in experimental models and in humans. The role of Schwann cells within the tumour microenvironment in liver cancer and melanoma will be analysed. The project will focus on the capacity of Schwann cells in modulating tumour angiogenesis and vascular mimicry which are essential steps in governing tumour growth, survival and invasion.

item.description:

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Study of the role of membrane potential in the regulation of cell fate and function, using integrated optogenetic and electrophysiological methodologies. (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Roma
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-06 Fisiologia

The researcher will investigate membrane potential as an instructive signal in the regulation of cell fate and function, employing integrated optogenetic and electrophysiological methodologies. The work will involve developing and applying protocols to modulate membrane potential through acute and chronic optogenetic stimulation, combined with intracellular (patch-clamp) and extracellular (multi-electrode array, MEA) electrophysiological recordings. Using neuronal and cardiac models, the project aims to assess how the modulation of membrane potential contributes to processes such as differentiation, functional maturation, and integration into pre-existing cellular networks.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: IpD48/2026: Extracellular Vesicles from Engineered Microalgae for the Sustainable Delivery of Ketocarotenoids and Tocopherol in Advanced Cosmetic Applications (Univ. VERONA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 13:00
Institution: Univ. VERONA, Verona
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-07 Biochimica

The researcher will carry out experimental activities within the ALGAVES project, aimed at developing extracellular vesicles (EVs) derived from engineered microalgae as delivery systems for ketocarotenoids and tocopherol. Activities will include EV isolation and purification and their characterization by NTA, TEM, DLS and Western blot. The researcher will contribute to bioactive compound quantification by HPLC and to EV uptake studies in HaCaT keratinocytes by confocal microscopy. Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects will be assessed through ROS and redox status. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Targeting MAcrophage metabolism to Reduce aggressiVE Liver metastases (MARVEL) ref. D.R. 126/2026 (HUMANITAS University)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 12:00
Institution: HUMANITAS University, Pieve Emanuele - Milano
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-08 Biologia molecolare

MARVEL aims to develop novel therapeutic strategies to tackle liver metastases from pancreatic and colorectal cancer by modulating macrophage functions within the tumor microenvironment. The project focuses on two key processes: the recruitment of circulating monocytes and the metabolic reprogramming of liver-resident macrophages, which contribute to establishing an immunosuppressive environment that supports metastatic progression.
